facts_of_case: Marriage between parties was solemnized in 2015. Differences arose, and husband filed for dissolution of marriage under Section 13(1)(ia)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. Wife preferred a divorce petition under Section 13 read with Section 25 of HMA.

legal_principles.principle: If petitions are presented to different District Courts, the petition presented later shall be transferred to the District Court in which the earlier petition was presented and both the petitions shall be heard and disposed of together.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted that it is an admitted position that the husband has preferred the petition for dissolution of marriage on 17.02.2022 and the wife has preferred the divorce petition on 25.03.2022, i.e., after approximately 53 days.

legal_principles.principle: The power of this Court under Section 24 of the Civil Procedure Code to transfer a suit or an appeal or other proceeding applies to an application for divorce filed under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act.
legal_principles.held: Before proceeding further, it is pertinent to consider that whether the power of this Court under Section 24 of the Civil Procedure Code to transfer a suit or an appeal or other proceeding applies to an application for divorce filed under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act or not.

outcome.final_order: Proceedings initiated by the other spouse to be transferred to the place where their application is pending.

use_for_drafting: advising on property division in divorce cases
